download_summsc_fidrag3B_model: download the SumMem-MSC 3B FiD-RAG model to a specified datapath directory
check_model_built_status: check if the summsc_fidrag3B model is already built using the built function
get_model_directory: get the model directory path for the summsc_fidrag3B model using get_model_dir
download_models_with_options: download model files using download_models with custom options and version parameters
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how the summsc_fidrag3B model is fetched and stored
